_about: Bad Eden Paths: Surge overlays chosen at 1st level (a second at 17th), each with three doctrines. Entries use the same shape as the universal Surge menu (cost, minProf, label, fiction, fx). 'doctrine' limits an entry to one doctrine; 'perk' marks free doctrine moves available from 1st level. Design source: the 'Bad Eden Paths' Claude Doc.

bulwark.name: Path of the Bulwark
bulwark.tagline: Set your feet. The line forms on you.

entry.name: Hold the Line
entry.description:
Hold the Line (free). Once per round, as a reaction when a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is targeted by an attack, you can become the target instead.

The wall runs on what hits it: the first time each round you take damage, you bank 1 Surge.

mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.tagline: You belong here now. Argue with the mountain.

perk.name: Rooted
perk.description: Rooted. You have advantage on Strength saving throws, and you can't be pushed or knocked prone while you haven't moved this turn.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.tagline: You do not stop. They learn this the hard way.

perk.name: No Terminal Velocity
perk.description: No Terminal Velocity. Your walking speed increases by 5 feet, and difficult terrain doesn't slow you.

cataclyst.name: Cataclyst
cataclyst.tagline: Something gives way. You aim where.

perk.name: Stance Dance
perk.description: Stance Dance. At the start of your turn you can take Advance or Anchor for free (from the Surge menu); it lasts until your next turn.

abilities.label: Brace the Line — +2 AC to you or a targeted ally against one attack
abilities.fiction: You set your shoulder where the blow will land.

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when the attack hits: it can turn the hit into a miss.

abilities.label: Steady Feet — advantage on Str and Dex saves; you can't be moved

fx.note: Until your next turn you can't be moved or knocked prone.

abilities.label: Absorbing Guard — resist one damage type; your next melee hit adds 1d6 of it
abilities.fiction: You take it in, and you keep it.

fx.auto: Your next melee hit adds 1d6 of the absorbed type.

abilities.label: Shelter — you and allies within 10 ft gain temp HP equal to twice your Prof
abilities.fiction: Stand behind me. All of you.

abilities.label: Bastion — 1 minute: +1 AC and resistance to weapon damage
abilities.fiction: You become the wall the others lean on.

fx.note: Concentration: it ends if your concentration breaks.

abilities.label: Unbroken — at 0 HP, rise to 1 and gain temp HP equal to your level (1/long rest)
The Last Wall — 1 minute: allies within 10 ft resist all damage
abilities.fiction: Everything they throw finds you first.

fx.note: For the duration you can't drop below 1 HP.

abilities.label: Denial — a creature trying to move past you stops dead
abilities.fiction: You decide which side of you is the wall.

fx.note: Use it as a reaction when a creature within 5 ft tries to move past you.

abilities.label: Shockwave Arrival — your next melee hit also strikes everyone around the target

fx.note: After moving at least 10 ft in a straight line, your next melee hit also deals its weapon damage to every other creature within 5 ft of the target (apply it from the damage card).

abilities.label: Advance — +2 melee damage, −1 AC until your next turn
Anchor — +1 AC, half speed until your next turn
Decide the Weather — a wall of debris, or an eruption
abilities.fiction: One. Or the other. Not both. Decide.

fx.note: Wall: a 30-ft line of debris gives full cover until it's cleared. Or Eruption: a 30-ft line, each creature makes a Dex save, 4d8 bludgeoning, half on a success.
